baselines.captureHelp: Every dated record of the project is copied into the baseline and the baseline is locked, so later slips show against it.
baselines.name: Baseline name
baselines.empty: No baselines yet. Capture one to measure schedule drift.
baselines.emptyReadOnly: No baselines yet. A producer captures them at each gate.
baselines.label: Schedule baselines
baselines.varianceLabel: Planned and current dates of the baseline's records

baselines.lateHours: {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} late
baselines.early: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} early
baselines.earlyHours: {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} early

backlog.title: Unscheduled ({count})
backlog.help: Records with no dates. Drag one onto a day, or press Schedule to choose the day.

backlog.pushes: {count, plural, one {It pushes # successor:} other {It pushes # successors:}}

retime.title: Retime by minutes
retime.offsetHelp: Hours and minutes, such as +1:30 or -0:15.

retime.previewPushes: {count, plural, one {This also pushes # successor.} other {This also pushes # successors.}}
retime.undoFailed: The retime could not be undone. Reload to see the record.

days.label: Day types
days.editorHelp: Say what the day is for. Split it into up to four parts when the day changes, such as a load-out in the morning and travel in the afternoon.
days.empty: No day types yet. Mark the load-in, show and load-out days so every schedule, calendar and day sheet shows them.
days.emptyReadOnly: No day types yet. Planners mark the load-in, show and load-out days here.
days.dayLabelHelp: Optional. Without one, the day reads as {type}.
days.zoneHelp: Leave it as the project's ({zone}) unless this part of the day happens somewhere else.
days.zoneFromVenue: Times read in the venue's zone, {zone}.
days.splitLimit: A day splits into at most four parts.
days.saved: {count, plural, one {Saved the day.} other {Saved the day's # parts.}}
days.removed: {count, plural, one {Moved a part of the day to Trash.} other {Moved # parts of the day to Trash.}}
days.undoFailed: The day could not be brought back. Restore it from Trash.

grid.title: {project} · {date} as a grid
grid.label: Records on {date}
grid.help: Type a row per record. Time reads shorthand such as 8a-10:30a, 830p or 20:30 on the project's clock ({zone}); an end before the start is the next day. Kind takes a record kind and Owner a person's name. Save shows what would change; Apply writes every row or none.
grid.badTime: This time does not read. Try 8a-10:30a, 830p or 20:30.
grid.badKind: Type a record kind, such as Task or Milestone.
grid.badOwner: No one with this name is in the organization.
grid.fix: {count, plural, one {Fix the cell marked before saving.} other {Fix the # cells marked before saving.}}
grid.preview: {created, plural, one {# new} other {# new}}, {changed, plural, one {# changed} other {# changed}}, {refused, plural, =0 {nothing refused} one {# refused} other {# refused}}.

dayTemplates.title: Day templates
dayTemplates.sentence: A day's records and cues saved once, such as a show day, with times kept from local midnight. Lay one onto another day from Schedule, Days, and check what it adds before applying.
dayTemplates.empty: No day templates yet. Open a day on Schedule, Days and save it as a template.
dayTemplates.loadFailed: The day templates could not be read. Reload the page.
dayTemplates.noItems: This template has no items yet.
dayTemplates.undoFailed: The template could not be brought back. Restore it from Trash.
dayTemplates.lengthHelp: Such as 45 or 1h30; empty means due then.
dayTemplates.saveHelp: Saves the day's records and its running order's planned cues, each at its time from local midnight.
dayTemplates.name: Template name
dayTemplates.applyHelp: What the day already holds and what the template adds, by time. Untick anything you do not want; items already on the day start unticked.
dayTemplates.runHelp: This day has more than one running order. Choose the one the cues join.
dayTemplates.summary: {count, plural, one {# item will be added} other {# items will be added}}; {overlaps, plural, =0 {none overlaps} one {# overlaps something already there} other {# overlap something already there}}.
dayTemplates.applied: {count, plural, one {Added # item from the template.} other {Added # items from the template.}}

anchor.setHelp: The day the plan counts from, usually the show day. Setting it moves nothing.
anchor.moveHelp: Choose the new anchor day and preview what moves with it. Shifts never move: booked people are rescheduled on Crew, Shifts.

anchor.later: {n, plural, one {# day later} other {# days later}}

workload.label: Workload
workload.help: Hours per person per day from shifts and estimated tasks, worked out as you read them. Days above {limit} hours read as over; org admins change the limit under Settings, Scheduling.
workload.tableLabel: Hours per person and day, {from} to {to}
workload.empty: No shifts or estimated tasks this week.

clashes.label: Clashes
clashes.help: People, suppliers and running orders that collide, worked out as you read them and shown only when you can read both sides. Changeovers under {changeover} minutes and travel within {buffer} minutes of a call are warnings. Each links to where it is fixed.
